verdict.rationale: Nix has no hosted account data to export, but its own documentation shows the user's state lives in plain-text declarative files such as /etc/nixos/configuration.nix and Nix expressions. It also offers a first-party exit path: `nix bundle` packages an application so it works outside the Nix store, and environments are described as easy to transfer between computers. This is a glancing, inferred fit rather than a documented data-export or offboarding capability. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export or migration feature, documentation that all user state is in open formats, documented guidance for leaving or uninstalling Nix, and independent corroboration.
